scope: Positions 1 through 500 in the 2026 Fortune ranking, reviewed for organization identity, external-classification crosswalks, first-party annual-report evidence, operating segments, and AMACS capability coverage.

regulatory_metadata_mirror.provenance_note: The mirror is a third-party transformation of the SEC nightly submissions archive and remains explicitly identified as such.

annual_report_evidence.provenance_note: AnnualReports.com is used only as a document host. A retrieved report is treated as company-authored first-party evidence only when the document itself identifies the resolved organization as registrant or author.

completion_rule: Every rank 1 through 500 must end with exactly one terminal evidence disposition; absence of accessible first-party evidence is recorded as evidence_unavailable rather than converted into a capability assertion.
boundaries: Fortune rank establishes cohort membership only and does not prove a capability.
External industry and SIC categories are crosswalk inputs, not AMACS aliases or organization capability evidence.
Regulatory metadata resolves likely reporting identity but does not prove market activity.
A mirrored annual report may support an activity observation only when the report itself identifies the reviewed organization and supplies the relevant statement or segment disclosure.
Private, mutual, cooperative, governmental, foreign, or otherwise unresolved organizations remain terminally classified as identity_unresolved or evidence_unavailable when appropriate.
No generated corpus record may be imported into a production organization profile or capability assertion without a separate authority and verification path.
